texts: Brane cosmology says our universe is a membrane adrift in a higher-dimensional $(thing)Bulk$(). The $(item)Brane Shifter$() slips me sideways into it, and back. It requires the Brane Cosmology research.

First crossing. The Bulk is an endless void of floating islands under the shadow of a vast hypercube - a four-dimensional cube, of which I only ever see a 3D shadow. Monoliths hide vaults of exotic materials, and $(item)Void Lattice Ore$() is common here.
Physics aside: in brane-world models only gravity leaks out into the Bulk, which might be why it is so much weaker than the other forces. Standing out here, I believe it.
Log, the Bulk, fifth crossing. It is not uniform. There are regions: the open $(thing)Bulk$(), the crystal $(thing)Graviton Reefs$() and the $(thing)Moduli Wastes$().

$(thing)Derelict Stations$() hold salvage and supplies - someone came here before me. $(thing)Collapsed Calabi-Yau Knots$() hang over the Wastes with caches at their hearts. In string theory, Calabi-Yau shapes are the tiny curled-up extra dimensions; these have come uncurled.

The locals:$(li)$(thing)Graviton Wisps$() pull you toward them and crush you up close.$(li)$(thing)Brane Striders$() slip between branes when hurt and leave you seeing double.$(li)$(thing)Moduli Crawlers$() hunt in packs and climb anything.$(br2)I keep my back to a wall. It does not help with the Crawlers.
Sunday. Even a lab deserves some style. Put a block of any high-tech material in a $(item)Stonecutter$() for plating, tiles, bricks and pillars - and back again, so nothing is wasted.

Surround a material block with glowstone dust for four $(item)Lamps$(). Most bricks and tiles also come as stairs, slabs and walls.$(br2)Chronosteel, Spacetime Alloy, Cosmic Neutronium, Dilithium and Void Lattice each have a storage block too - which is how I keep the hoard tidy.
Nether expedition, day 2. $(item)Dilithium$() grows down here. Its lattice is porous to antimatter, which makes it the only practical regulator for an annihilation reactor.

Field notes: annihilation turns all the rest mass of matter and antimatter into energy - E = mc², the full amount, against under 1% for fusion. The hard part has always been holding antimatter without it touching anything. A crystal it can pass through gently is exactly what such a reactor needs.
Survey notes. $(item)Cherenkov Quartz$() grows deep in the deepslate layer. $(item)Degenerate Matter$() is found in End stone; smelt or blast it into $(item)Neutronium$().

$(item)Void Lattice$() only forms in the Bulk.$(br2)Names explained: Cherenkov light is the blue glow of particles outrunning light in a medium. Degenerate matter is what remains when atoms are crushed until only quantum exclusion holds them up, as in white dwarfs and neutron stars.

Day 9. Found one: a crashed research observatory, its containment dome cracked, a supply cache still inside. They dot the Overworld. Who built them, I don't yet know.$(br2)A good source of early Cherenkov Quartz and Neutronium - worth a detour before I can make either myself.
